import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class TotalChargesCleaner(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="TotalChargesCleaner",
        kind=OperatorKind.IMPUTER,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="将total_charges字段中的空白字符串转换为数值，并处理异常值以符合后续模型计算需求",
        conditions=["数据包含 total_charges 列且该列含有空白字符或被识别为字符串"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "numpy"],
        params={"col": "total_charges"},
        parent="TotalChargesCleaner@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, col="total_charges"):
        self.col = col

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        """记录列名并返回 self"""
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        """
        修正 total_charges：
        1. 复制输入数据以防原地修改
        2. 将字符串两端的空白符清除
        3. 利用 pd.to_numeric 将非数值转为 NaN
        4. 使用 0 填充缺失值（代表新入网用户）
        """
        X = X.copy()
        if self.col in X.columns:
            # 执行类型转换：先转字符串并去除空格，coerce 非法值为 NaN，最后填补为 0
            X[self.col] = pd.to_numeric(
                X[self.col].astype(str).str.strip(), 
                errors="coerce"
            ).fillna(0.0)
            
            # 确保最终列为浮点型，并处理任何可能产生的 inf 值
            X[self.col] = X[self.col].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
            
        return X

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class IdColumnDropper(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="IdColumnDropper",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="自动识别并剔除高基数ID类列，防止模型过拟合及维度灾难",
        conditions=["数据集包含唯一标识列"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "numpy"],
        params={"id_cols": ("customer_id",)},
        parent="IdColumnDropper@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, id_cols=("customer_id",)):
        self.id_cols = id_cols

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        """
        验证输入数据结构并记录状态。
        """
        self.cols_to_drop_ = [c for c in self.id_cols if c in X.columns]
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        """
        执行删除操作。
        """
        X = X.copy()
        
        # 剔除预定义的ID列
        cols_actually_dropped = [c for c in self.cols_to_drop_ if c in X.columns]
        X = X.drop(columns=cols_actually_dropped)
        
        # 逻辑兜底：检查是否存在其他疑似高基数ID的列（超过行数90%的唯一值）
        # 避免在线上推理阶段因为动态列名导致的问题
        potential_ids = [
            col for col in X.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns 
            if X[col].nunique() / len(X) > 0.9
        ]
        X = X.drop(columns=potential_ids)
        
        return X

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class TenureBucketizer(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    """
    在网时长分箱，将 tenure 离散化为 [0-6, 6-12, 12-24, 24-48, 48+]，提升模型对不同生命周期用户的识别。
    """
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="TenureBucketizer",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="在网时长分箱，提升模型对不同生命周期用户的识别",
        conditions=["数据包含数值列 tenure"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "numpy"],
        params={"col": "tenure"},
        parent="TenureBucketizer@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, col="tenure"):
        self.col = col

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        # 记录转换逻辑所需状态
        self.bins_ = [-1, 6, 12, 24, 48, np.inf]
        self.labels_ = ["0-6", "6-12", "12-24", "24-48", "48+"]
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        
        # 处理可能的缺失值和类型异常：先确保数值化
        if self.col in X.columns:
            # 使用 pd.to_numeric 处理可能存在的字符串格式或非法值
            col_data = pd.to_numeric(X[self.col], errors='coerce')
            
            # 对缺失值补 0 或其他填充策略（参考 lessons: 填补为 0）
            col_data = col_data.fillna(0)
            
            # 执行分箱逻辑
            bucket_name = f"{self.col}_bucket"
            X[bucket_name] = pd.cut(
                col_data, 
                bins=self.bins_, 
                labels=self.labels_
            ).astype(str)
            
            # 处理分箱后可能产生的 NaN (例如超出 bin 范围)
            X[bucket_name] = X[bucket_name].fillna("unknown")
            
        return X

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    """
    计算月均消费与当前月费的比值特征，衡量用户消费变动趋势。
    """
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="构造月均消费与当前月费的比值特征，捕捉消费变动趋势",
        conditions=["输入数据包含月费、总费用及在网时长字段"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "numpy", "sklearn"],
        params={"monthly": "monthly_charges", "total": "total_charges", "tenure": "tenure"},
        parent="ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, monthly="monthly_charges", total="total_charges", tenure="tenure"):
        self.monthly = monthly
        self.total = total
        self.tenure = tenure

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        self.columns_ = X.columns.tolist()
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        
        # 预处理：确保数值列类型正确，处理空白字符串及非数值
        # 先转为字符串去除空格，再转为数值，缺失值填充为0
        total_series = pd.to_numeric(X[self.total].astype(str).str.strip(), errors='coerce').fillna(0.0)
        tenure_series = pd.to_numeric(X[self.tenure], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0)
        monthly_series = pd.to_numeric(X[self.monthly], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0)
        
        # 计算逻辑：平均消费 = 总消费 / 在网时长
        # 为避免除以0，使用 np.where 处理 tenure 为 0 的情况
        avg_charge = np.where(tenure_series > 0, total_series / tenure_series, 0.0)
        
        # 计算比值：charge_ratio = avg_charge / current_monthly_charge
        # 为避免除以0，当月费为0时，结果置为 1.0 (表示无变动)
        ratio = np.where(monthly_series > 0, avg_charge / monthly_series, 1.0)
        
        # 处理可能产生的无穷值与缺失值
        res = pd.Series(ratio, index=X.index)
        X["charge_ratio"] = res.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(1.0)
        
        return X

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class ServiceCountFeature(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="ServiceCountFeature",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="统计客户订购的增值服务数量，捕捉客户对平台的粘性特征",
        conditions=["数据包含增值服务相关类别列"],
        dependencies=[],
        params={"service_cols": ("online_security", "tech_support", "streaming_tv")},
        parent="ServiceCountFeature@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, service_cols=("online_security", "tech_support", "streaming_tv")):
        self.service_cols = service_cols

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        # 无需训练状态，记录列信息即可
        self.feature_names_in_ = X.columns.tolist()
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        
        # 统计服务计数
        # 逻辑：对于指定的列，若值为"Yes"或"是"则记为1，处理缺失值或未见类别不会报错
        n_services = pd.Series(0, index=X.index)
        for col in self.service_cols:
            if col in X.columns:
                # 统一转字符串并剔除空格，兼容不同语言编码
                col_vals = X[col].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
                n_services += (col_vals.isin(["yes", "是"])).astype(int)
        
        X["n_services"] = n_services
        
        # 处理新特征可能产生的缺失/无穷值（本逻辑下不会产生，但遵守规范）
        X["n_services"] = X["n_services"].fillna(0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)
        
        return X

lessons.title: 样本不平衡导致默认模型召回率偏低
lessons.trigger: 流失场景存在正负样本不平衡，模型默认阈值或未配置样本权重时召回率达不到业务要求
lessons.fix: 启用平衡类权重（如 class_weight='balanced' 或 BalancedLightGBMClassifier）以提升召回率

lessons.title: 逻辑回归标准化与可解释性
lessons.trigger: 使用逻辑回归模型，或者需要模型具有高可解释性时
lessons.fix: 必须先进行特征标准化（如 StandardFeatureScaler），在 0.1~10 之间搜索正则化强度 C，可直接输出系数给业务方。

lessons.title: 随机森林防过拟合与召回优化
lessons.trigger: 使用随机森林模型，面临过拟合风险，或业务要求召回优先时
lessons.fix: 设置 n_estimators 300 左右，限制 max_depth 在 8~16 防止过拟合；召回优先时需配合调整分类阈值。

lessons.title: 数值列含空白字符导致类型转换失败
lessons.trigger: 新入网客户累计消费为空白字符串，读取为 object 类型，转 float 时抛出 ValueError: could not convert string to float: ' '
lessons.fix: 先 str.strip()，再 pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce')，缺失值填补为 0

lessons.title: LightGBM 调参及不平衡处理
lessons.trigger: 数据量在 5k 到 10w 之间，或者样本不平衡时
lessons.fix: 设置 num_leaves 15~63, learning_rate 0.03~0.1, n_estimators 200~600；不平衡时设置 class_weight='balanced'；树模型无需标准化。
